# Using Untangle Codebase in Muse Code

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to Muse Code.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.agents/skills/untangle-codebase/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.agents/skills/untangle-codebase/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness muse --skill untangle-codebase
node packages/cli install --harness muse --skill untangle-codebase --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. Muse Code loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also name it in the request, for example: "Use the untangle-codebase skill to ...".

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.agents/skills/untangle-codebase` for a project install, or `~/.agents/skills/untangle-codebase` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Run `muse skills list` to see the skills Muse discovered.

## Notes

- Based on one community report: muse skills list scans ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude/skills, and ~/.codex/skills.
- Documentation: [Muse Code](https://www.withone.ai/blog/muse-code-skills-not-mcp) (path source: community).
